```{r knitr-setup, include=FALSE, purl=FALSE}
## Rendering set-up only (not part of the analysis code). The working directory used by the
## analysis is the repository folder below; PRINCE_ROOT is set by run_pipeline.sh.
```

## Overview

Several Extended Data panels were first rendered by the version-1 and version-2 figure scripts (`comp_11_extended_figures`, `comp_14_revised_figures`). This step copies them into `results/Manuscript_v3/` under the numbering of the v3 figure set, together with the exported gene-set table (Supplementary Data 5). Later figure scripts and the supplementary-table builders read these files from `Manuscript_v3/`. No computation is done here.

**Manuscript items supported**

- Intermediate figure files used by `comp_25_supp_tables_v3`, `comp_28_figures_v4` and later steps
- Supplementary Data 5 (gene sets), copied forward

**Pipeline step:** `./run_pipeline.sh --only 21b_assemble_v3`. Approximate runtime: seconds.

**Inputs**

- `results/Manuscript/ExtendedDataFig{1,7,8,10}.{pdf,png}`
- `results/Manuscript_v2/ExtendedDataFig9.{pdf,png}`
- `results/Manuscript/Supplementary_Data_5_gene_sets.csv`

**Outputs**

- `results/Manuscript_v3/ExtendedDataFig{1,6,7,8,10}.{pdf,png}`
- `results/Manuscript_v3/Supplementary_Data_5_gene_sets.csv`

**Depends on**: `comp_11_extended_figures`, `comp_14_revised_figures`, `comp_12_export_genesets`, `comp_21_figures_v3`

## Analysis

Load the shared set-up (folder definitions).

Copy each figure in both PDF and PNG format to its v3 number: version-1 Extended Data Fig. 1, 7, 8 and 10 become v3 Extended Data Fig. 1, 8, 7 and 10, and version-2 Extended Data Fig. 9 becomes v3 Extended Data Fig. 6. `file.copy` is wrapped in `stopifnot`, so a missing source file stops the pipeline.

```{r comp-21b-assemble-v3-01}
## ============================================================================
## PRINCE -- assemble the v3 Extended Data / Supplementary figure set
## Copies figure files rendered by earlier figure scripts into Manuscript_v3/
## under the numbering used by the v3 figure set, which later figure scripts and
## the supplementary-table builders read from.
## ============================================================================

source(file.path(Sys.getenv("PRINCE_ROOT", "."), ".build", "comp_00_guard.R"))

cp <- function(from, to) stopifnot(file.copy(file.path(COMP_DIR, from), file.path(COMP_DIR, to), overwrite = TRUE))
dir.create(file.path(COMP_DIR, "Manuscript_v3"), showWarnings = FALSE)
for (e in c("pdf", "png")) {
  cp(paste0("Manuscript/ExtendedDataFig1.", e),     paste0("Manuscript_v3/ExtendedDataFig1.", e))
  cp(paste0("Manuscript_v2/ExtendedDataFig9.", e),  paste0("Manuscript_v3/ExtendedDataFig6.", e))
  cp(paste0("Manuscript/ExtendedDataFig8.", e),     paste0("Manuscript_v3/ExtendedDataFig7.", e))
  cp(paste0("Manuscript/ExtendedDataFig7.", e),     paste0("Manuscript_v3/ExtendedDataFig8.", e))
  cp(paste0("Manuscript/ExtendedDataFig10.", e),    paste0("Manuscript_v3/ExtendedDataFig10.", e))
}
cp("Manuscript/Supplementary_Data_5_gene_sets.csv", "Manuscript_v3/Supplementary_Data_5_gene_sets.csv")
cat("v3 figure set assembled\n")
```
